title: Meera's opening month
body: Meera started a stationery business. During her first month the following transactions took place: (1) She started the business with cash Rs. 4,00,000. (2) She deposited Rs. 3,00,000 of this cash in a bank account. (3) She bought machinery for Rs. 1,50,000, paying Rs. 30,000 by cheque; the balance is payable to the supplier later. (4) She bought goods on credit from Lalit Traders for Rs. 40,000. (5) She sold goods costing Rs. 20,000 for Rs. 32,000 in cash. (6) She withdrew Rs. 8,000 in cash for personal use. Meera wants to check her records by preparing the accounting equation after every transaction.
